selection: all eight visits in each selected sweep, both RX sessions; 64 dwells
arithmetic_reference: independent integer convolution of sealed Q15 coefficients, round ties toward positive infinity, saturate after each stage
scientific_comparator: 257-tap Kaiser beta 8.6, 1MHz cutoff, factor-four reference plus same six-window-screen/one-confirmation detector; report candidate differences separately from RF truth
limits: Development and synthetic controls are not holdout sensitivity or false-alarm calibration. A timing pass does not qualify boundaries, receiver binding, live RF coexistence, transport, analysis, web assets or deployment. No thresholds or holdout selections may be tuned after inspecting holdout outcomes.
